full_prompt_en: A square dark character artwork is divided vertically into two related views of a lone gunfighter. The left section is a close view of the lower half of an adult face beneath the brim of an oversized black hat. Long dark hair falls beside the cheek, while the eyes are entirely swallowed by the brim's shadow. The mouth is closed and severe. A high charcoal collar, layered scarf, and round metal clasp gather at the throat. The hatband has faint embossed ornament, visible only where a low gray highlight grazes it. The right section shows the same kind of figure from about the knees upward, turned three-quarters left against a smoky brown-gray field. The wide hat again conceals the eyes. A long dark leather coat has a high shoulder cape, strap-like closures, belted waist, and heavy sleeves; a gloved hand holds a long-barreled revolver upright beside the chest. The two views overlap in mood rather than forming a sequential action. Everything is close in value: black, charcoal, worn brown, and dim gray. Soft side lighting picks out the nose, lip, clasp, leather folds, gun metal, and hat edge, leaving most of the body in deep shadow. Smoke or grain softens the background without defining a place. The vertical division creates a graphic comparison between facial detail and full costume silhouette. Surfaces look weathered and tactile, especially the creased leather and slightly tarnished metal. No other figures, scenery, or readable words appear. The pose is still and guarded, and the image depends on withheld facial information, restrained contrast, and Gothic western clothing for its tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形深暗角色图沿竖向分成同一类孤独持枪者的两个相关视角。左区近距离展现成年人的下半张脸，脸上方被过大的黑色帽檐遮住。长深发沿脸颊垂下，眼睛完全吞没在帽檐阴影里；嘴闭合而严厉。高炭灰领、层叠围巾和圆形金属扣在喉头汇合。帽带上的浅浮雕花纹只有在低弱灰色高光擦过处可见。右区从膝部以上描绘同类人物，身体向左成四分之三侧转，站在烟雾般棕灰色域前。宽檐帽再次隐藏双眼。长深色皮大衣有高肩披片、带状扣合、束腰和厚重袖子；一只戴手套的手在胸旁竖握长枪管左轮。两个视角由氛围而非连续动作相连。色调都很接近：黑、炭灰、磨旧褐与暗灰。柔和侧光拣出鼻、嘴唇、扣件、皮革褶皱、枪身金属和帽边，其余大部落在深影中。烟气或颗粒柔化背景，却不界定地点。竖向分幅使面部细节与全套服装剪影形成图形对照。表面磨旧而可触，尤其是起皱皮革与略失光泽的金属。没有其他人物、景物或可读文字。姿态静止而戒备，图像依靠被隐藏的面部信息、克制对比和哥特西部服装制造张力。
style_prompt_en: A low-key Gothic character treatment uses near-black, charcoal, worn brown, and dim gray in a narrow tonal range. Soft side lighting grazes selected ridges and edges while large areas disappear into shadow. Weathered leather-like folds, embossed ornament, layered fabric, and tarnished metal receive fine tactile detail; the background remains smoky and undefined. A vertical split pairs a close cropped detail with a more distant costume silhouette, making scale change part of the composition. Wide angular shadow shapes conceal information and heighten tension. The image avoids bright accent colors, relying instead on selective highlights, grain, and dense dark massing. The finish is cinematic and painterly, reserved in gesture and heavy with guarded atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 低调光的哥特式角色处理在狭窄调性范围内运用近黑、炭灰、磨旧褐与暗灰。柔和侧光擦亮少数凸起和边缘，大面积形体消失在阴影里。磨损皮革般褶皱、浮雕花纹、层叠织物和失去光泽的金属获得细微可触细节；背景保持烟雾状、不界定场所。竖向分幅并列近距离局部与较远的服装剪影，让尺度变化成为构图的一部分。宽阔而带棱角的暗形隐藏信息并增强紧张感。画面不靠亮色重音，而依靠选择性高光、颗粒和浓重深色团块。完成度兼具电影感与绘画性，动作克制，氛围戒备而沉重。
theme_en: A shadowed wide-brim-hat gunfighter in a split Gothic character study
theme_zh: 分幅哥特式角色画中，宽檐帽下隐于阴影的持枪人
name: Helsing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
